free_tier.stated: A CNY 300 no-threshold voucher quoted as 通过学生认证的高校学生，可领取300元云工开物学生专属优惠券, plus access to a student compute package across thirteen instance shapes. The credit is real and large for this market; the door is the finding.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: If a user ever holds an enrolled affiliate, this is the single largest no-card cloud credit found in the Chinese market and it stacks with the student priced instances, which are sold separately from the voucher.
limits_note: Nothing throttles the voucher itself, but the status lapses after 30 days and the account cannot be re-verified after graduation, so the credit is a one-shot that cannot be renewed by waiting.
binding_note: Nothing throttles the voucher itself, but the status lapses after 30 days and the account cannot be re-verified after graduation, so the credit is a one-shot that cannot be renewed by waiting.

identity_cost.detail: Verification requires full-time enrolment at a mainland Chinese higher-education institution, checked against the national student register , on an account that has already passed Alipay real-name certification. One account per identity card, and the student status expires every 30 days and must be re-verified. The vendor states that students in Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan go through manual review instead, so the general route is closed to anyone not enrolled in a Chinese institution.

evidence.proved: page states 通过学生认证的高校学生，可领取300元云工开物学生专属优惠券, quoted
page states the offer is for 中国内地高校的在校大学生 and requires 普通全日制 enrolment verified against 学信网 plus Alipay real-name certification, quoted
page states 学生身份的有效期为30天 and that a verified account cannot be moved to another account, quoted
the FAQ limits the general student benefit to students of Chinese institutions including the mainland, Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan

notes: This is the refutation case: CNY 300 with no threshold is the headline number every Chinese blog repeats, and the gate is a national student register rather than an email domain. dossier/compute/ holds alibaba-cloud-international.json and alibaba-ecs.json but no student programme record, so the corpus previously had no way to answer this question either way.
